# Comfy Wan2.5- Image to Video

Transform images into videos with synchronized audio, enhanced motion, and superior quality. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_wan_image_to_video.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.prompt: A cinematic, over-the-shoulder shot of a modern military conflict in a vast, arid desert landscape. The foreground is heavily blurred, showing the back of a soldier's camouflaged helmet and weapon, creating a first-person perspective from behind rocky cover. In the sun-drenched midground, soldiers in full desert combat gear are positioned around armored tanks on the sandy terrain; one soldier is crouched and aiming their rifle. A large, violent explosion erupts with orange fire and billowing tan smoke behind the central tank. In the far background, a range of rugged, snow-capped mountains rises against a clear, bright teal-blue sky. The image has a shallow depth of field, a distinct teal-and-orange cinematic color grade, and a tense, action-packed atmosphere.
